dailySchedule.activation: After cloud authorization, deployment and noncalling verification
dailySchedule.priority: Yesterday first; then unfinished prior-day campaign records; then oldest unprocessed backlog
dailySchedule.completionCheck: Inspect the registered Samvaad campaign. When it is Completed, reconcile a fresh result export, hold unresolved rows individually, and create the next campaign on the same day within calling hours.
dailySchedule.endOfDay: Permanently stop the unfinished campaign at 18:00 IST. Never resume or re-run it.
dailySchedule.nextDay: Create NEW campaigns: yesterday first, then unfinished campaign records, then older backlog after a fresh source read and final outcome reconciliation. Never resume yesterday's campaign.
dailySchedule.pendingAttempts: Retain prior call IDs and Attempt 1/2. Undialed rows get two total attempts; rows with one prior unconnected attempt get only Attempt 2, with retries off.

callingWindow.appliesTo: lead and payment calling, including tests
callingWindow.samvaadCampaignSetting: Set and reopen When Calls Can Run: 10:00–18:00 IST, all seven days
callingWindow.activeCampaignCutoff: Samvaad controls queued dialing using the saved campaign calling window; behavior at the cutoff has not been observed in a live campaign

testRuns.recipientPolicy: No one- or two-recipient cap. Every section processes all valid rows from its current saved sheet under the agreed source date rules.
testRuns.source: The current saved link in Lead Calling Test (test_lead) or Payment Reminder Test (test_payment) under Bhago Mobility in InsightDesk; each section saves independently
requiredBeforeEveryTest: Read the saved URL for the requested test section again; never assume the previous URL is still current or use the other test section's URL.
Read the current spreadsheet metadata and latest populated rows.
Lead calling uses name and mobile; city is optional. Payment calling retains name, mobile and vehicle, with outstanding amount as an additional field.
Create a new calling CSV from that fresh read; never reuse an earlier test's data without verification.
Compare every Samvaad preview recipient and field with the freshly read sheet before launching.

lead.dateDefault: previous day in India time for Swiggy and Zomato; explicit date ranges override it

payment.date: Retained for processing only; never placed in Value 3

callingRoutes.trigger: Save the current source sheet link, then RUN reads it, prepares the local CSV, creates the campaign and starts calls automatically.

QWQER.reinstatement: Only on explicit instruction; gaining Editor access alone does not reinstate calling

resultCapture.implementationStatus: Implemented; authenticated Sheets write/read-back and genuine completed payment result verified
resultCapture.attemptStorage: Separate Attempt 1 and Attempt 2 columns on the original source row, each with call ID, called-at time, status, duration, outcome, summary, callback details and recording link when available
resultCapture.retryOwner: Samvaad; do not create extra retry campaigns
resultCapture.rowMatching: Saved source workbook/tab, durable row UUID, phone, name, date and payment vehicle
